name: Fundamentals of Energy Economy
description:
- Basic concepts and definitions in energy economics,
- Structure and development trends in energy supply and use,
- Fundamentals of energy supply under market conditions,
- Fundamentals of power plant technology (combustion calculation, cycle, and plant engineering),
- Methods for modeling and analyzing energy technologies, plants and systems,
- Technical, energy-related, and economic description and balancing of energy use from energy services to primary energy,
- Fundamentals, technologies, and potential of renewable energies
